description:
Love Modern Marvels? Stay up to date on all of your favorite History shows at https://history.com/schedule.

Chronicles one of the most incredible engineering feats of all time: construction of the 51-mile canal that took ten years to build and employed over 40,000 workers, 6,000 of whom died from various diseases, in Season 1, Episode 3, "Panama Canal".

#HISTORY #ModernMarvels

Follow Adam Richman as he travels the country and tries the most iconic and forgotten foods of the 1980s. Watch new episodes of Adam Eats the 80s Sundays at 10/9c on The History Channel.

Watch more Modern Marvels on YouTube in this playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4F4CD715F1A3E6C7&cmpid=Social_YouTube_ModernMarvelsPlaylist

Find out more about the show on our site:
https://www.history.com/shows/modern-marvels

"Modern Marvels" goes beyond the basics to provide insight and history into things we wonder about and that impact our lives.

comments.text: Hello, I'm someone who is from Panama, and although I really enjoyed your video, I'm quite disappointed the fact you left out Manuel Amador Guerrero, who is one of our key revolutionaries and the man who promoted the idea of separating from Colombia, whose wife designed our flag. The video came off as Panamanians simply left all the work to this French guy, when simply that is not true. Manuel actually traveled to the US and tried to lawyer up and get a chance to speak with the President, but no one wanted to help him. That’s when his last resort was Philippe. Panamanians had the idea of separating from Colombia way before him; multiple uprisings had already been brutally shut down. My main point is you skipped one of our main figures and the one who truly fought for our country and had no choice but to hand it over to Philippe, who actually had contacts and influence. This is what we are taught at school, and it's not very nice that our first President and the man who gave it all for our independence still continues to be overshadowed by Philippe.
